examples.name: Sample — two footnotes inside a shaded frame
paragraphs: Footnotes 1 and 2 sit inside the grey-bordered panel that frames the trading table, under the Total row, in a smaller face. Both follow the table as footnote text; the superscript markers stay in the header cells and the Other trading label. Only the year band and the Total row are printed bold; the hyphenated header wraps (per- / form- / ance) are joined.
